items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new queue work. Do not extrapolate this one-day result or compare it to September AI spend of $934.99756275 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29. Contribution margin, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, ROI, payback, forecasts, and cost-to-learn are unknown.

Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and deployed-work measurement. The minimum evidence for contribution margin and cost-to-learn is a dated ledger matching each revenue and cost item to the same site or content and period, including AI, infrastructure, labor, operating costs, commitments, and budget ceilings, plus an approved learning threshold and outcome metric. Preserve unavailable values as unknown; do not treat missing revenue or telemetry as zero.

AI usage is a material exposure signal, not proof of performance: 5,174 calls, 229 errors, and $934.99756275 total cost across 39 instrumented sites during 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29. The arithmetic average is approximately $0.18 per call, but cost-to-learn is not calculable because no approved learning threshold, attributable outcome, matching-period revenue, or infrastructure allocation exists. Retain AI guardrail review as deferred report-only analysis; do not change models, schedules, credentials, billing, or spend.
